summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.55/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.55 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 15, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 9¢ higher than a week ago, 22¢ lower than a month ago, and 66¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.33) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.79).
